SELECT to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp, 'YYYY') || '-Q' || to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp::timestamp, 'Q') AS quarter_label, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS delivery_late_rate FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_ts)s AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < %(end_ts)s GROUP BY quarter_label ORDER BY quarter_label ASC LIMIT 100

SELECT to_char(o.order_purchase_timestamp, 'YYYY"-Q"Q') AS quarter_label, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_delivered_customer_date > o.order_estimated_delivery_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS delivery_late_rate FROM v_o_orders AS o WHERE o.order_status = 'delivered' AND o.order_delivered_customer_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_estimated_delivery_date IS NOT NULL AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= %(start_ts)s AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < %(end_ts)s GROUP BY quarter_label ORDER BY quarter_label ASC LIMIT 100

WITH state_aov AS (SELECT o.customer_state AS customer_state, SUM(p.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS state_aov FROM v_o_orders AS o JOIN v_o_payments AS p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable') GROUP BY o.customer_state), overall AS (SELECT SUM(p.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS overall_aov FROM v_o_orders AS o JOIN v_o_payments AS p ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled','unavailable')) SELECT s.customer_state AS customer_state, s.state_aov AS state_aov, ov.overall_aov AS overall_aov FROM state_aov AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS ov WHERE s.state_aov > ov.overall_aov ORDER BY s.state_aov DESC LIMIT 100

SELECT o.customer_state AS state, SUM(p.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS aov FROM v_o_payments AS p JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY o.customer_state HAVING SUM(p.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) > (SELECT SUM(p2.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id), 0) FROM v_o_payments AS p2 JOIN v_o_orders AS o2 ON o2.order_id = p2.order_id WHERE o2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable'))

SELECT s.state, s.aov FROM (SELECT o.customer_state AS state, SUM(p.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id), 0) AS aov FROM v_o_payments AS p JOIN v_o_orders AS o ON o.order_id = p.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') GROUP BY o.customer_state) AS s CROSS JOIN (SELECT SUM(p2.payment_value) / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT o2.order_id), 0) AS overall_aov FROM v_o_payments AS p2 JOIN v_o_orders AS o2 ON o2.order_id = p2.order_id WHERE o2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')) AS g WHERE s.aov > g.overall_aov
